basic_info.description: Best Potrero North Slope Location!  Top floor in a three-unit building.  Big SF skyline view from most rooms and deck.  Remodeled 1908 Edwardian with 2 or 3BR (double parlor), 1 split bath, separate home office, pantry or baby's room and a large living room-kitchen-dining area plus a dining area with a City view!  Modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances, double wine refrigerator and a whisper-quiet Bosch dishwasher. Lots of light, all hardwood floors and high ceilings. Two rooms have bay windows.  Washer and dryer in unit.  Great location close to Potrero Hill shops and restaurants.  Cross Street is 18th Street.  Easy access to Hwys. 101 and 280, minutes to UCSF and tech offices. No parking in the building, but easy street parking and a resident parking sticker are available.  Staging By Studio M and photos by Open Homes.
